## Toronto 1-Bed Rental Search Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

You want a **1-bedroom in Toronto** for **move-in on 2026-10-01**, capped at **CAD 2,350/month**, with **pet-friendly** approval for **one cat**, plus **in-unit laundry** and a **30-minute transit commute or less** to downtown. The best approach is to search by commute-first neighborhoods, then filter hard on pet policy and laundry.

## Best Neighborhood Targets and Feature Ranking
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

| Priority | Feature | Why it matters | How to screen fast |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **30-minute transit commute** | Non-negotiable for your 3 office days | Check TTC/GO trip time to your exact office address |
| 2 | **Pet-friendly for one cat** | Must-have lease fit | Confirm cats allowed in writing before applying |
| 3 | **In-unit laundry** | Strong daily convenience | Look for “ensuite laundry” or “in-suite washer/dryer” |
| 4 | **Budget at or below CAD 2,350** | Keeps search realistic | Set max alert at **CAD 2,350** and avoid bidding wars |
| 5 | **Downtown access + stable transit** | Protects commute reliability | Prioritize subway, GO, or frequent streetcar routes |
| 6 | **Building quality / heat / noise** | Affects long-term comfort | Read reviews and ask about noise, utilities, and maintenance |

### Neighborhoods to prioritize
- **Liberty Village / Fort York / CityPlace**: strong downtown access, many condo rentals, often in-unit laundry
- **St. Lawrence / Corktown / Distillery area**: very commute-friendly, but budget can be tight
- **Bloor-Yonge / Church-Wellesley / Yonge & St. Clair**: excellent transit, search early for pet-friendly units
- **The Junction / High Park / Roncesvalles**: better value, still feasible if your office is on a subway line
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d6/Raccoon_in_High_Park_01.jpg Alt=The Junction / High Park / Roncesvalles**: better value, still feasible if your office is on a subway line, Toronto, Canada
- **East York / Leslieville / Riverdale**: often good for pet-friendly units and transit access, commute depends on office location

### Search strategy
- Start with listings that explicitly say **pet-friendly** and **in-unit laundry**
- Filter for **1-bedroom** only; avoid “bachelor” unless size is clearly workable
- Search by **commute time**, not just neighborhood name
- Use a two-step filter:
  - Step 1: budget + move-in date + pet-friendly
  - Step 2: in-unit laundry + transit access + building reviews
- Ask for **exact transit commute** to your office address before applying
- Be ready with application docs: ID, proof of income, employment letter, references, credit report, and tenant history
- If the market is tight, consider:
  - older but well-kept rental buildings
  - smaller condos with rentals
  - slightly west/east neighborhoods with direct subway access

## Landlord Message Template
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/phone.svg

Subject: Inquiry for 1-Bedroom Rental in Toronto Starting October 1, 2026

Hello,

I’m interested in your 1-bedroom rental and wanted to confirm a few details before applying.

I’m looking for a move-in date of **2026-10-01** and my budget is up to **CAD 2,350/month**. I commute downtown **3 days per week**, so I’m especially interested in locations with a **30-minute transit commute or less**.

I also have **one cat** and am looking for a **pet-friendly** unit with **in-unit laundry** if available. If the apartment is still available, could you please confirm:
- Whether cats are allowed
- Whether in-unit laundry is included
- Any utilities not included in rent
- The nearest transit options and approximate commute to downtown
- Application requirements and earliest showing availability

Thanks for your time. I’d be happy to share my application details if the unit is a fit.

Best,
[Your Name]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Email]
